basis: The dashboard shows May at roughly 8,000–8,500 kWh, which is far below the next lowest month (Jun, about 17,500 kWh) and below the 10,000 kWh tick, while the other months range from about 20,000 to 40,000 kWh. This isolated, extreme drop in output is the basis for treating May as a critical low-output anomaly rather than a routine low-output case. No explicit threshold is printed, but the magnitude of the deviation relative to the other months supports escalation.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-output anomaly review
